bugs.title: Out-of-order billing refresh rolls back membership ownership
bugs.root_cause: Concurrent restore and purchase verification check only account ownership, not server stateRevision/stateObservedAt. A late older snapshot replaces latestSnapshot and private _ownsMembership despite GameStore having its own independent ordering guard.
bugs.behavioral_proof: A late inactive restore permits purchase(yearId) to return true and invoke the fake native launch despite a newer confirmed active monthly subscription. Reverse ordering also incorrectly blocks legitimate renewal.
bugs.fix: Validate complete bounded version metadata; retain current snapshot/ownership when older revision, older same-revision observation or legacy-after-versioned response arrives. Legacy-only backend and new-owner revision reset remain supported.

bugs.title: Late friendly join replaces an unrelated top route
bugs.root_cause: FriendlyOnlineScreen._openMatch uses Navigator.pushReplacement without checking foreground/current route. A valid delayed join response replaces a separately pushed page above Friendly.
bugs.fix: Restrict presentation/user actions to the current resumed owner page. Keep accepted matches pending while covered/paused, clear consumed room tracking, and navigate this page exactly once after it becomes current/resumed. Exit cleanup remains owner guarded.
